about_the_game:
SURVIVE. COMPETE. DOMINATE.

Step into SORROW: Rise of Divinity, an open-world battle arena where strength, strategy, and survival instincts decide your fate. Whether you’re a seasoned gamer or new to competitive adventure, this game challenges you to rise above all odds and claim your place at the top.

🔥 Battle Royale & Tournaments—Enter intense arenas where only the strongest survive. High-risk, high-reward showdowns keep every moment thrilling and unpredictable.
🏆 Trophy Hunting—Seek powerful trophies that enhance your combat abilities and unlock new gameplay options, giving you the edge over rivals.
🌎 Massive Open World—Explore a dynamic, living world filled with hidden dangers, secret opportunities, and a legacy waiting to be built.
⚔️ Missions & Survival Challenges—Accept daring contracts, fight relentless enemies, and push your skills to the limit in unforgiving environments.
💰 Earn & Upgrade—Use your winnings to improve gear, customize your character, and unlock exclusive content that shapes your unique playstyle.

CURRENTLY IN BETA TESTING — EARLY ACCESS COMING JANUARY 22, 2026

We’re actively testing the game with dedicated players in beta right now, fine-tuning every detail based on real feedback. Early Access officially launches on January 22, 2026, on Steam, at a special discounted price.

JOIN EARLY ACCESS TODAY — AT A SPECIAL DISCOUNT

As a thank-you to early supporters, we’re offering a 90% discount off the planned full release price.

  • In the US, the full price will be $149.99, with Early Access at approximately $14.99.

  • In Europe, the full price is planned at €149.99, with Early Access around €14.99.

Prices vary by region—please check your local Steam store page for exact details. This discount is limited and won’t last long, as development is progressing rapidly.

WHAT TO EXPECT IN EARLY ACCESS

We’re excited to announce that the first major feature launching soon is the Deathmatch system—a fast-paced, competitive mode where skill and strategy will determine the victor.

This new mode will be available early during the Steam Early Access phase, giving players an opportunity to experience core gameplay and provide valuable feedback.

We’re committed to regular updates and expanding the game based on the community’s input as development progresses.

ARE YOU READY TO PROVE YOURSELF?

Add the game to your wishlist and follow us on Steam to stay updated on the latest news, development progress, and launch details.

Visit our official website to learn about exclusive early support opportunities, including early beta access and special rewards.

Join us on this epic journey and help shape the future of SORROW: Rise of Divinity from the ground up!
